items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: I was working with Elliott Lawrence and things were bad for big bands

ctx.x: Yeah. Broadway shows, all those kinds of things.

Well the way I got into Broadway shows, I was working with Elliott Lawrence and things were bad for big bands and we were doing just weekends. And finally he said, “I’m going into the theater I’m going to take the band into the theater.” So I said what did I want to do that for, because that was a schlock job in those days. I mean nobody wanted to play in the theater. It was like working in a submarine. But he said we were going to go in and we’d be able to take off and all that, which you weren’t able to do in…
Oh. You’d just get a sub?
